content.subject: Fulfyld fulfillment services and manual handoffs
content.draft_text:
Hi AJ,
Fulfyld lists a broad set of fulfillment and 3PL services across multiple channels. Such breadth creates manual handoffs between order intake and carrier booking, increasing error risk. We feed order data into a reconciliation engine that matches shipments to inventory, reducing manual effort. Would you have 20 minutes next week to see if this fits your workflow?
